purpose: [OPTIMIZED] Finds artifacts matching a symbol name and returns their details.
parameters: symbol_name (string, optional, default ""): target symbol name, exact active artifact ID (e.g. 'A855/4'), or full canonical identity ('pkg.mod::symbol').
limit (integer or null, default 20): maximum number of matching artifacts returned; pass null for all matches.
evidence_limit (integer or null, default 20): maximum number of consumer identities per artifact.
compact (boolean, default true): when true, returns up to 3 bounded consumer evidence items per artifact with total, truncated, and expand metadata; set to false for full consumer lists.
fields (array of strings or null, default null): optional projection list of top-level keys to return; null returns full response.
symbol (string or null, optional, default null): alias for symbol_name.
behavior:
Resolution order:
1. Existing live symbol search (exact & partial substring matching).
2. Exact active artifact ID or full canonical identity via active registry.
3. Bounded fuzzy suggestions (score >= 0.75, max 5) on textual not-found.
4. Legacy not-found string fallback when no fuzzy candidates qualify.
usage_notes: LLM use: narrow ambiguous names before increasing ``limit``.
examples:
Searches by partial, case-insensitive match against the symbol part of
the artifact's full name (the part after '::', e.g. 'generate_graph'
matches 'generate_graph_analytics_report'), by exact artifact ID ('A855/4'), or by full canonical identity.
